docs.title: Joeven – AI/ML Zero to Hero 🚀
docs.text:
Welcome to JØEVEN AI/ML Academy, your one-stop platform to learn:

  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Machine Learning
  • Deep Learning
  • Python
  • Data Engineering basics
  • Real projects

All content is designed for absolute beginners to advanced level.

Use the sidebar to navigate through Zero-to-Hero learning paths & video playlists.

docs.title: AI/ML Zero to Hero Roadmap
docs.text: This roadmap will take you from absolute beginner to job-ready ML Engineer.

docs.title: 🧭 Step-by-step Path
docs.text:
1. Python Basics
  2. Essential Math
  3. Data Handling (NumPy, Pandas)
  4. ML Algorithms
  5. Neural Networks
  6. Deep Learning Frameworks
  7. MLOps Basics
  8. Real Projects

Each chapter contains: - Explanation - Code - Practice tasks - Video references
